integrity: The total statement follows from the exact simplicial-vertex set. The outer statement is proved by classifying every mutually maximally distant pair, yielding the full strong resolving graph. The dual statement uses the convex-complement characterization and explicit shortest-path witnesses to exclude every competing pair and every larger general-position set.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for n at least four because n=3 has an additional maximum dual general-position pair.
Finite exhaustive verification covers n from four through seven and is corroborative only.
A recent strong-metric result on chain graphs is closely related through the strong resolving graph, but its published summary does not state the outer general-position clique structure.
A differently phrased or non-indexed treatment of these variants on half graphs may exist.
title: Total, outer, and dual general position in half graphs
